t: A small ritual for someone in pain
a: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا. بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا، يُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
p: Bismillāh, turbatu arḍinā, bi-rīqati baʿḍinā, yushfā bihi saqīmunā, bi-idhni rabbinā.
m: In the name of Allah, the dust of our land, with the saliva of some of us, by which our sick one is cured, by the permission of our Lord.
